identity_lock.character: the exact default Raidline infected enemy
required_features: same pale gray-green skin and glowing pale eyes
same torn charcoal hooded jacket and trousers
same pixel density, outline weight, palette and top-down three-quarter camera
forbidden_changes: text, labels, frame numbers or guides

enemy_default_attack_grab.motion: track the target while advancing at normal speed, visibly coil forward through frames 0-2, then make a restrained two-frame arms-first lunge in frames 3-4; frame 5 is a low committed follow-through that can hand off to the existing off-balance treatment on a miss

enemy_default_attack_scratch.motion: short readable shoulder-and-claw windup in frames 0-1, one close-range horizontal rake with clear contact silhouette across frames 2-4, compact recovery in frame 5; feet remain planted around the common pivot

enemy_default_attack_bite.motion: close grapple continuation: brace and pull target inward in frames 0-1, thrust head and jaw forward for a heavy bite across frames 2-4, then release into a hunched recovery in frame 5; no separate free-standing chase attack
